domain_vault.badge_subtitle: OMNIA never registers domains in its own name. Contractual promise, no fine print.

domain_vault.policy_required_error: You must accept the Domain Sovereignty Policy to continue.
domain_vault.policy_subtitle: OMNIA's contractual promise: your domain stays yours, forever.
domain_vault.policy_intro: This policy is an integral part of the OMNIA subscription agreement. By signing it, OMNIA commits to respecting the principles below for the entire duration of the relationship and even after its possible termination.
domain_vault.policy_p1_title: 1. The domain belongs to the customer
domain_vault.policy_p1_text: OMNIA does not register third-party domains in its own name. Every customer remains the sole Registrant of their own domain (`.it`, `.com`, `.eu`, etc.) with their trusted Registrar. OMNIA acts exclusively as a technical service provider.
domain_vault.policy_p2_text: At any time, the customer can point their domain to another provider via DNS records. OMNIA provides free assistance for outbound transfers and applies no penalties or hidden fees.
domain_vault.policy_p3_text: OMNIA does not require powers of attorney, delegations, or permanent access to the customer's Registrar panel. Every technical action is performed via records provided by the customer. The AuthInfo/EPP code of the domain remains exclusively in the customer's control.
domain_vault.policy_p4_text: At the end of the contractual relationship with OMNIA, the customer keeps: (a) the domain, (b) the property archive in standard XML format, (c) the client contacts archive in CSV, (d) any uploaded files (photos, floor plans, PDFs). No lock-in.
domain_vault.policy_p5_text: Every DNS change performed by OMNIA at the customer's request is logged and made available in the control panel. No silent changes.
domain_vault.policy_p6_title: 6. What happens if OMNIA ceases operations
domain_vault.policy_p6_text: In the unlikely event of a wind-down, OMNIA will provide 90 days advance notice: complete data export, migration guide, referrals to alternative hosting. The customer's domain was never OMNIA's — it remains their property.
domain_vault.policy_footer: Last updated: February 2026. This policy constitutes a binding contractual commitment. For questions or independent audits, write to legal@omniarealestateecosystem.it.
